learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the basics of machine tools, forming machines, industrial robots and manipulators.

syllabus_topics: Handling equipment - introductory terms and definitions
Industrial robots and manipulators (PRaM) and working heads PRaM
Automated workplaces for forming and welding
Importance, division and basic classification of forming machines
Energy forming machines, Die casting machines
Sorting machine tools according to the degree of automation
Service, safety and construction of forming machines
bibliography: P., C., Sharma: A Textbook of Production Technology: Manufacturing Processes, Sharma, P. C. 2006, ISBN- 978-8121911146
Khanna O., P.,: Production Technology Volume I, SCHAND 2017, ISBN: 9789383182046
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
